The bass guitar follows the root notes of the guitar riff with a distorted, clanky tone. 120 BPM, 4/4 time signature, Key of E minor. The arrangement is centered on a repetitive four-bar loop with a sudden stop at the end of the phrase.

drums.tags: ASMR soundscape featuring rhythmic friction and percussive textures. The primary sound source is a hand rhythmically rubbing and scratching against a textured, slightly resonant surface, likely a plastic or metallic mesh. The performance consists of rapid, alternating strokes creating a high-frequency white noise profile with a consistent 120 BPM pulse. Short, sharp fingernail taps provide transient accents against the continuous sliding friction sounds. The recording is dry with minimal room reflection, emphasizing the close-mic proximity effect and high-end detail of the surface contact. The rhythm follows a steady sixteenth-note pattern with occasional syncopated pauses.
